summary: Gone fire lookout site in Webster County, also listed as Holly River (Pickens); administered by the West Virginia Conservation Commission. No build date or description found.

facts.status_note: Listed as gone; no source read describes what remains at the site.

events.note: West Virginia forest fire towers closed statewide (e-WV); context only, not a site event

evidence.supports: Location in Webster County, West Virginia
Administered by the West Virginia Conservation Commission
Elevation of the site, 2,761 ft (842 m)
Other name Holly River (Pickens); listed as gone

evidence.supports: About 100 towers run by federal and state forestry agencies once stood in the state

evidence.supports: Forest fire towers in West Virginia closed in 1990
evidence.quote: After decades of service West Virginia's forest fire towers were closed in 1990.

notes_for_editor: Only the FFLOS record and the FFLA list describe this site, and both mark it gone. The FFLA list gives the other name Holly River (Pickens); no source read explains the name. No build date, builder, staffing or removal date was found. A Wikipedia article on Holly River State Park was checked only in its matched lines, and no source read links it to this lookout, so it is not used. The Division of Forestry tower list PDF on wvnet.edu could not be fetched (DNS error). The e-WV entry is used for statewide context only. The brief's coordinates and elevation agree with the sources; no corrections proposed.
